about: What the editor knows about each enemy. Claude regenerates this from the prefabs (rewards, lives) when they change.

enemies.name: worm
enemies.does: Tunnels under you and leaps up to catch you in the air.

enemies.name: rock thrower
enemies.does: Keeps its distance and lobs rocks at random spots around you.

enemies.name: giant
enemies.does: 4 m tall with a club. Needs a double jump to stomp.

enemies.name: archer
enemies.does: Keeps its distance and shoots arrows where you're about to be.

elites.does: Bigger, helmet and shield, longer club. Swings faster when enraged.
Shoots volleys of 3 arrows. 5 when enraged.
